search.global.no_results.context: Empty-state message in the global topbar search results dropdown.

search.global.section_article.context: Section label above article results in the global search dropdown.

search.global.section_news.context: Section label above news results in the global search dropdown.

search.global.section_video.context: Section label above video results in the global search dropdown.

search.history.empty_dropdown.context: Empty-state message shown in the search-input dropdown before any query is typed, when the user has no search history.

search.history.recently_viewed_heading.context: Section heading in the search-input dropdown listing recently viewed articles.

search.history.recent_searches_heading.context: Section heading in the search-input dropdown listing recent search queries.

search.global.search_error.context: Error message shown in the search dropdown when the search request fails. A near-identical message exists for the KB grid search, see search.kb_grid.search_error.

search.kb_grid.search_error.context: Error message shown in the Knowledge Base grid when a search request fails (byte-identical to search.global.search_error but a separate DOM host).

search.kb_grid.no_results.context: Empty-state message in the Knowledge Base grid search results (has a trailing period, unlike search.global.no_results).

search.history_tab.heading.context: Heading of the profile tab listing the user's full search history.

search.history_tab.clear_button.context: Button to clear the on-screen search history list; the '(visual only)' qualifier indicates it doesn't delete server-side history, text spans lines 1418-1419 in source.

search.history_tab.column_query.context: Table column header. Byte-identical header reused in the admin popular/failed-searches tables (base-layout.html:1594,1612).

search.history_tab.column_date.context: Table column header in the search history tab.

search.history_tab.empty_state.context: Empty-state table row in the search history tab. Byte-identical to the compliance nudge-history empty row (base-layout.html:4367 context) — kept separate per-component.

search.admin_stats.popular_searches_head.context: Heading of the admin-dashboard popular-searches analytics panel.

search.admin_stats.column_search_count.context: Table column header showing how many times a query was searched.

search.admin_stats.failed_searches_headi.context: Heading of the admin-dashboard zero-result-searches analytics panel.

search.admin_stats.column_failed_attempt.context: Table column header showing zero-result search attempt counts.

search.ai_assistant.heading.context: Heading of the floating Magti AI chat-assistant panel.

search.ai_assistant.subtitle.context: Subtitle under the AI assistant heading.

search.ai_assistant.greeting.ka: გამარჯობა! მე ვარ Magti AI ასისტენტი. რით შემიძლია დაგეხმაროთ დღეს? დასვით კითხვა ცოდნის ბაზის შესახებ.
search.ai_assistant.greeting.en: Hello! I'm the Magti AI Assistant. How can I help you today? Ask me a question about the Knowledge Base.
search.ai_assistant.greeting.context: Initial greeting bubble shown when the AI assistant panel opens.

search.ai_assistant.input_placeholder.context: Placeholder text in the AI assistant chat input.

search.ai_assistant.coming_soon_toast_ti.context: Toast title for a 'coming soon' placeholder shown when an unimplemented AI feature is triggered.

search.ai_assistant.coming_soon_toast_bo.context: Toast body for the AI 'coming soon' placeholder; repeats at static/js/app-core.js:5363.

search.ai_assistant.coming_soon_alert.context: Alert (fallback when toast isn't available) for the AI 'coming soon' placeholder; repeats at static/js/app-core.js:5366.

search.ai_assistant.you_label.context: Avatar label for the current user's own chat bubble in the AI assistant conversation.

search.ai_assistant.found_info_prefix.ka: ვიპოვე შესაბამისი ინფორმაცია ჩვენს ცოდნის ბაზაში:
search.ai_assistant.found_info_prefix.en: I found relevant information in our Knowledge Base:
search.ai_assistant.found_info_prefix.context:
Prefix sentence the AI assistant uses to introduce a matched KB result, followed by the excerpt (source string includes trailing '

' markup).

search.ai_assistant.no_info_found.ka: სამწუხაროდ, ამ თემაზე ინფორმაცია ვერ მოვიძიე. სცადეთ სხვა სიტყვებით ძებნა (მაგალითად: "როუმინგი", "IPTV", "მობილური").
search.ai_assistant.no_info_found.en: Unfortunately, I couldn't find information on this topic. Try searching with different words (for example: "roaming", "IPTV", "mobile").
search.ai_assistant.no_info_found.context: Fallback response when the AI assistant's simple keyword search finds nothing relevant in the KB.
